R: Distance of the ground clock from Earth's center
f: Tick rate of a clock (Δf/f: how much faster it runs)
r: Distance of the orbiting clock from Earth's center
t_gravity: Δt_gravity: time the orbiting clock gains per day from being higher up
t_speed: Δt_speed: time it loses per day from its speed
v: Speed of the clock, in a frame that does not turn with Earth
v_g: Speed of the ground clock, in the same frame
